title: Summarize text
summary: Summarizes text with the on-device model, in the style asked for (short notes, one paragraph, or a spoken script) and within a word budget.
whenToUse: Use when text from a page, a PDF, a document or a transcript is longer than what the person asked for.

arguments.name: style
arguments.description: notes, paragraph or script (a spoken script in plain sentences)

arguments.name: maxWords
arguments.description: The longest the summary may be, in words; 150 when empty

example: Summarize this in five bullet points
